sloka: सर्वे सुबलसम्पन्नाः सर्वे विकीर्णकीर्तयः।सर्वे समरमासाद्य न श्रूयन्ते पराजिताः।देवैरपि सगन्धर्वैः सकिन्नरमहोरगैः ।। ६.६९.१२ ।।
transliteration: sarve subalasampannāḥ sarve vikīrṇakīrtayaḥ।sarve samaramāsādya na śrūyante parājitāḥ।devairapi sagandharvaiḥ sakinnaramahoragaiḥ ।। 6.69.12 ।।

translations.english: All sons of Ravana possessed stupendous strength, all were very famous, and never got defeated in war be it Gandharvas, Kinnaras or even gods will get vanquished by them.
